decisions.decision: Commission requires construction schedule with stabilization and replication during construction phase, driveway constructed with rain garden prior to building, and replication area monitored over 2 growing seasons by certified wetland scientist for 108 Sunny Hill Road NOI-26-24
decisions.quote: the commission is requiring a construction schedule with the stabilization and replication done during the construction phase with the driveway constructed at the same time as the rain garden and prior to the construction of the building. the replication area must be monitored over 2 growing seasons by a certified wetland replication scientist.
